description: This Java class 'AlertReminderTask' is a scheduled task in the OpenMRS platform that retrieves unread alerts and sends notification messages to associated users.

classes.name: AlertReminderTask
classes.description: A scheduled task that retrieves unread alerts in the OpenMRS system and sends reminder messages to the relevant users.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that retrieves unread alerts and initiates the process of sending notifications.

methods.name: sendAlertNotifications
methods.description: Creates and sends a notification message to users with unread alerts.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Identifies and returns a collection of users who have unread alerts that need notifications.
